description: This file contains functions for downloading a browser with progress indication, including retry logic, process management, and progress display utilities, specific to the Playwright project.

methods.name: downloadBrowserWithProgressBar
methods.description: Main function to download a browser with progress bar, with retry logic and error handling.

methods.name: downloadBrowserWithProgressBarOutOfProcess
methods.description: Performs the download in a separate process, monitors progress, and checks for success.

methods.name: logPolitely
methods.description: Logs messages to the console based on environment log level.

methods.name: getDownloadProgress
methods.description: Selects appropriate progress display function based on TTY support.

methods.name: getAnimatedDownloadProgress
methods.description: Provides animated progress bar for TTY terminals.

methods.name: getBasicDownloadProgress
methods.description: Provides basic textual progress indicator for non-TTY environments.

methods.name: toMegabytes
methods.description: Converts bytes to a human-readable megabytes string.
